extracted.intended_audience: prospective undergraduate students interested in creative writing
extracted.subtask_description: Information about Sewanee's undergraduate Creative Writing program (major and certificate), its curricular tracks, and instructional methods (workshops, use of existing works). Intended to describe what the program emphasizes and how it teaches craft.

rubrics_metrics.name: Foster your craft
rubrics_metrics.description: Whatever style of writing you like, the literary offerings here at Sewanee will foster your craft
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program emphasis is on developing the student's craft across different styles; the phrase signals sustained, practice-based instruction rather than one-off exposure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communicate with grace and clarity
rubrics_metrics.description: teach you to communicate with grace and clarity
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instruction aims not only at creative expression but at clarity and stylistic refinement—students are expected to develop readable, well-crafted prose or verse.

rubrics_metrics.name: Find relevance between the pages
rubrics_metrics.description: —all while finding relevance between the pages
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Students are guided to draw connections and discover thematic or contextual relevance within and among texts, suggesting attention to interpretation and meaning as part of craft development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Degree tracks: Fiction, Playwriting, Poetry
rubrics_metrics.description: the University now offers a major in creative writing with three different tracks (Fiction, Playwriting, or Poetry)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program structure allows specialization; choice of track informs coursework, workshop focus, and the type of writing students will develop.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certificate program in creative writing
rubrics_metrics.description: In addition to the major, there is a certificate program in creative writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An alternative credential/pathway is available for students who may not pursue the major but want formalized instruction in creative writing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use existing creative works to learn styles and elements
rubrics_metrics.description: Using existing creative works to help you understand styles and elements
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pedagogical method includes close reading and analysis of published works as models for style, form, and literary elements; students learn by examining examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Workshops focused on peer critique of original work
rubrics_metrics.description: workshops focus on critiquing your original work with a group of your peers
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Workshop pedagogy centers on group feedback: students submit original pieces and receive critique from classmates, fostering revision skills and critical reading; implies expectations of participation and constructive critique.
